findings.quote: $BTC up 5.2% since midnight, the biggest move on the board
findings.why: The live market block lists $SOL at +6.01% UTC-day against $BTC at +5.24%, so BTC is not the largest move shown.
findings.fix: Drop the superlative or attach it to $SOL, e.g. 'and $BTC up 5.2% since midnight'.

findings.quote: BofA is playing the gap between the two ends, buying $TLT on the view that Treasury buybacks in the 20- to 30-year sector hold longer-dated yields down while the 2-year stays pinned.
findings.why: BofA's context entry ties its $TLT curve trade to 'Fed focus on inflation and restrictive policy will flatten the curve' and has BofA short 2y USTs expecting further tightening (not a pinned 2-year); the buyback-anchors-the-long-end rationale is Goldman's ('the beefed-up buyback program will help anchor the 15-20y sector and push the curve flatter'), and BofA itself calls the buyback impact 'modest'.
findings.fix: Restate as BofA buying $TLT on the view that continued Fed tightening flattens the curve, with the 2-year pushed higher rather than pinned.
